changelog:
⚠️ Version 1.2.3 Update:
• Re-enabled automatic announcements and developer popups.
• Full Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode support.
• Screen lock gestures blocker with floating unlock overlay.
• Optimized player lifecycle during lock/unlock transitions.
• Settings 6-card theme layout redesign.
• Adaptive tablet grid layout columns.
• Light theme contrast fixes.
• International channels collapsed by default.
• Enhanced application security.
updateMessage: Version 1.2.3 Stable is now available with popup fixes and optimizations.
